name: schema-canvas
description: Turn a database schema (Prisma or Postgres) into one self-contained, interactive ER-diagram page with current-vs-target diff and an in-browser editor.
author: CodeOfRob

scripts.example: node bin/schema-canvas.mjs model --prisma examples/bookshop/schema.prisma --name bookshop -o examples/bookshop/current.model.json && node bin/schema-canvas.mjs build --current examples/bookshop/current.model.json --target examples/bookshop/target.model.json --layout examples/bookshop/layout.json --config examples/bookshop/config.json -o examples/bookshop/out/page.html
